name: Busway tap-off connection
summary: The connection of an outgoing circuit to a plug-in busway through a tap-off unit, usually containing a protective device.
description: This symbol shows a tap-off unit plugged into the busway, with the outgoing circuit leaving through a fuse or circuit breaker in the unit. On single-line diagrams it replaces the board-and-feeder pattern used for switchboards, since the busway itself acts as the distribution bus.

The connection symbol does not show the tap-off unit rating unless annotated. Tap-off units may be fused or contain a breaker, and they usually have an interlock preventing insertion or removal under load. The protective device inside the unit should be drawn with its own symbol and rating.
readingNotes: Read the protective device rating in the tap-off unit.
Check selectivity between the tap-off device and busway upstream protection.
drawingChecklist: Draw the protective device in the tap-off.
distinction: A busway tap-off is a plug-in connection with its own protection; a one-line bus tap is a generic connection to a busbar.
